title: First Ramadan Fast: Gradual Training and Motivation
summary: Fasting is training in willpower and taqwa. Before puberty fasting is not obligatory for your child, so train him gradually according to his health and ability (part of the day, then a full day), and stop the training if he becomes tired or ill; fasting part of the day is training, not a Ramadan day's fast. Once he reaches puberty, fasting Ramadan becomes obligatory for him, so ask a scholar you trust if he has an excuse such as illness, and consult the doctor if he has a health problem. Create joy and beloved rituals for Ramadan. A beautiful experience ties worship to happiness, not deprivation.
try_this: This week (or in Ramadan): Agree with your child on a suitable fasting goal, and celebrate their achievement.
reflection_prompts: How was your child’s experience with fasting?
What makes it appealing to them?
